name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
description: Affordable housing scheme providing credit-linked interest subsidy for home purchase or construction for low and middle-income groups.
offline_explanation: PMAY helps low and middle-income families buy or build their first home with government interest subsidy on home loans.
benefits: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh on home loans

name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments to eligible landholding farmer families across India.
offline_explanation: PM-Kisan provides ₹6,000 yearly direct cash support directly to the bank accounts of small and marginal farmer families.
benefits: ₹6,000 annual cash transfer in 3 instalments of ₹2,000

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension scheme for workers in the unorganised sector after reaching 60 years of age.
offline_explanation: APY gives unorganised sector workers a guaranteed government monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after turning 60.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 post age 60

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Government-backed small savings scheme for girl children offering high tax-free interest and long-term financial security.
offline_explanation: SSY is a high-interest savings scheme for girl children under 10, providing tax-free maturity funds for education and marriage.
benefits: 8.2% annual compound interest with 100% tax exemption under Section 80C

name: MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹10 lakh for micro and small non-farm enterprises in Shishu, Kishor, and Tarun categories.
offline_explanation: MUDRA offers collateral-free business loans up to ₹10 lakh to small entrepreneurs, shopkeepers, and artisans.
benefits: Collateral-free loans: Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishor (up to ₹5L), Tarun (up to ₹10L)

name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
description: Health insurance scheme offering ₹5 lakh cover per family per year for secondary and tertiary cashless hospitalisation.
offline_explanation: PM-JAY provides free cashless health insurance up to ₹5 lakh per year per family at empaneled hospitals across India.
benefits: Cashless health cover up to ₹5,000,000 per family per year

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
description: Central and state scholarships providing financial aid for school and higher education to students from economically weaker sections.
offline_explanation: NSP provides scholarships to students from school to college level to cover tuition fees and educational expenses.
benefits: Direct bank transfer of scholarship amounts ranging from ₹2,000 to ₹50,000 per year

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Comprehensive crop insurance protecting farmers against yield losses caused by non-preventable natural risks, pests, and diseases.
offline_explanation: PMFBY insures farmers' crops against weather damages and pests at low subsidized premium rates.
benefits: Complete insurance payout for crop damage with low farmer premium (1.5% to 2%)

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Bank loan assistance between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for SC, ST, and Women entrepreneurs to set up greenfield enterprises.
offline_explanation: Stand-Up India facilitates bank loans up to ₹1 crore for SC/ST and female entrepreneurs starting new business ventures.
benefits: Bank loans from ₹10 lakh up to ₹1 crore with subsidized interest rates

name: PM SVANidhi Scheme
description: Special micro-credit facility providing street vendors with collateral-free working capital loans up to ₹50,000 with interest subsidy.
offline_explanation: PM SVANidhi gives street vendors collateral-free loans up to ₹50,000 with cashback incentives for digital transactions.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000, ₹20,000, and ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy
documents_required: Vending Certificate / Urban Local Body ID Card

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Comprehensive support scheme for traditional artisans and craftsmen providing skill training, toolkit incentives, and collateral-free credit.
offline_explanation: PM Vishwakarma provides traditional artisans ₹15,000 toolkit grants and ₹3 lakh collateral-free loans at 5% interest.
benefits: ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, ₹500/day training stipend, and loans up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest

name: PM POSHAN Scheme
description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing free balanced hot-cooked nutritional meals to primary and upper primary school students.
offline_explanation: PM POSHAN provides free nutritious daily lunches to school students in government and government-aided schools.
benefits: Free daily cooked mid-day meal with guaranteed nutritional standards

name: PM KUSUM Scheme
description: Subsidized solar pump scheme enabling farmers to install off-grid solar agriculture pumps and sell excess solar power to the grid.
offline_explanation: PM KUSUM provides farmers up to 90% subsidy for installing solar water pumps for farm irrigation.
benefits: Up to 90% total subsidy (60% central+state subsidy, 30% bank loan) for solar agricultural pumps

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
description: Financial, technical, and business support for individual micro food processing units, self-help groups, and producer cooperatives.
offline_explanation: PMFME offers 35% credit-linked capital subsidy up to ₹10 lakh for setting up or upgrading micro food processing businesses.
benefits: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy up to ₹10 lakh for food processing machinery and infrastructure

name: Bihar Krishi Input Subsidy Scheme
description: State government scheme providing direct financial compensation and seed/fertiliser subsidies to Bihar farmers affected by natural disasters.
offline_explanation: This Bihar state scheme subsidises seeds and fertilisers for registered farmers facing agricultural losses.
benefits: Subsidy up to ₹13,500 per hectare for unirrigated and irrigated agricultural land loss
documents_required: DBT Bihar Agriculture Farmer Registration ID

name: NSFDC Term Loan Scheme
description: Term loan scheme providing financial assistance up to ₹30.00 lakhs to Scheduled Caste (SC) entrepreneurs for setting up income generating ventures.
offline_explanation: Provides loans up to ₹30 Lakh for SC entrepreneurs at very low interest rates (6-8%) to start or expand businesses.
benefits: Loan up to ₹30 Lakhs at 6% to 8% interest p.a.

name: NBCFDC Term Loan Scheme
description: Financial assistance scheme for Other Backward Classes (OBC) entrepreneurs to start self-employment and income generating activities.
offline_explanation: Provides loans up to ₹15 Lakh for OBC entrepreneurs at subsidized interest rates to help them build businesses.
benefits: Loan up to ₹15 Lakhs at 6% to 8% interest p.a.

name: PM-DAKSH Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH) Yojana offers free skill development training programs to SC, OBC, EBC, DNT, and Safai Karamcharis.
offline_explanation: Offers high-quality free skill training for marginalized groups along with stipend and placement assistance.
benefits: 100% free training, stipend of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 per month, and job placement assistance.

name: Venture Capital Fund for SCs
description: Venture Capital Fund to promote entrepreneurship among Scheduled Castes by providing concessional finance to SC-owned companies.
offline_explanation: Provides funding from ₹20 Lakhs to ₹15 Crores for established SC entrepreneurs and startups.
benefits: Concessional finance up to ₹15 Crores (Max 75% of project cost) at 4% to 8% interest.

name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana
description: Microfinance scheme for female entrepreneurs to start small businesses with concessional interest rates.
offline_explanation: Provides easy microfinance to women starting self-employment ventures.
benefits: Loans up to ₹1.4 Lakhs at subsidized interest rates (approx 4% p.a.).
